newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Davox, Hartford options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Davox, Hartford options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said it will list options on Davox Corp shares on June 3 and those on Hartford Life Inc on June 6.
Both will have initial strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with expirations in June, July, September and December, the exchange said.
Position limits are 7,500 contracts for Davox and 4,500 for Hartford.
GHM Inc will be the specialist for Davox options on the AMEX floor, while Spear, Leeds & Kellogg will be the specialist for Hartford.
